# Security

Hangar's job is to keep what runs in a VM away from your Mac and your network. If you find a way around that, or any
other security problem, please report it privately to [security@baseguard.net](mailto:security@baseguard.net) or
through [GitHub's vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/baseguard/hangar/security/advisories/new) rather than
in a public issue. We'll answer within a week.

Only the latest release is supported.
